Description: Modification to an SB35 application utilizing State Density Bonus, deemed Compliant on August 23, 2023 (PLN2023-0017) for the project at 3120-30 Shattuck Avenue (APN 52-1554-4). The original application included demolition of a non-residential building and construction of a 54,285 sq. ft. Gross Floor Area (46,960 sq. ft. Residential Gross Floor Area), eight-story (86’-5”), 65-unit, mixed-use building with 7,325 sq. ft. commercial area and basement space. The proposed modification includes the construction of a 54,894 sq. ft. Gross Floor Area (47,940 sq. ft. Residential Gross Floor Area), eight-story (84’-2”) 65-unit, mixed-use building with 2,638 square feet ground floor commercial area and eliminates the basement space. The unit mix is modified in this version.
